WITH city_data AS (
    SELECT 
        trim(substr(a.address_details,
                     instr(a.address_details, char(10)) + 1,
                     instr(substr(a.address_details, instr(a.address_details, char(10)) + 1), ',') - 1
                    )) AS city,
        ca.customer_id,
        a.address_id
    FROM Customer_Addresses ca
    JOIN Addresses a ON ca.address_id = a.address_id
)
SELECT 
    city,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT address_id) AS average_density
FROM city_data
GROUP BY city;
